blocks.text: Open Terminal from the desktop menu or press Super+Return. Foot is a native Wayland terminal. Commands run as your account unless you explicitly authorize an administrative operation.

Foot settings live in ~/.config/foot/foot.ini. Desktop Appearance edits supported presentation fields. Keep a backup before manual edits. The managed launcher owns terminal service lifetime and environment.

Select text and press Ctrl+C, or use a code block's Copy button. Paste into the terminal with its paste shortcut/menu, inspect every argument, and press Enter only when you intend to run it. Words such as HOST, USER and PORT are placeholders you must replace.
Copied commands can modify the system when run. Never paste an unreviewed multiline command or an authentication secret into a terminal.
